title: Hong Kong to Macau: The Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Express
subtitle: A 2-day cross-border EV adventure via the world's longest sea bridge

route.kidActivities: Hong Kong Disneyland (pre-trip), Chimelong Ocean Kingdom
Macau Giant Panda Pavilion, Macau Science Center, Macau Tower

bestFor: Adventurous families wanting a unique cross-border bridge experience
tips: China uses GB/T standard — vehicle must be GB/T compatible
Requires Guangdong temporary license plates — pre-booking necessary
State Grid chargers available at most highway rest stops in Guangdong
